qualityHelp: 適用於 JPEG 同 WebP。PNG 係無損。
autoCaptureHelp: 關閉時會先顯示選項；撳「截圖」先開始。
languageHelp: UniSS 介面語言。預設係英文。
statusReadyCapture: 就緒 — 撳「截圖」攞螢幕截圖。
formatHint: 輸出：{fmt}（{quality}）— 可喺設定更改。
formatHintTip: 輸出格式同畫質。喺設定度改。
statusHintTip: 狀態同下一步會喺呢度顯示。
errCannotCapture: 呢個頁面截唔到（chrome://、about:、商店頁面等）。請開普通 http/https 分頁。
errClipboard: 呢個瀏覽器唔支援將圖像複製去剪貼簿。
errNoEditImage: 冇圖像可以編輯。請先喺彈出視窗截圖，再撳「編輯」。
statusMove: 拖曳去移動 — 鬆手去放置。
statusEmpty: 空白範圍 — 冇揀到嘢。
statusTextAdded: 已加文字。用「選擇 / 移動」調位置。
statusAdded: 已加入。用「選擇 / 移動」或者「刪除」。
pageInfoBar: Show page title and URL on the screenshot
pageInfoBarHelp: Adds a full-width black bar at the top with the tab title and address on the left.
errClipboardDenied: Could not copy to the clipboard. Try again or use Download.
clearTempCapturesHelp: Removes Region stash and Edit handoff images left in extension storage. Your settings and downloaded files stay.
aboutBlurb: UniSS captures, annotates, and downloads screenshots on your device. There is no account and no UniSS server.
statusCropping: Crop — drag to move, handles to resize. Enter apply, Esc cancel.
cropHint: Enter apply · Esc cancel · Shift locks aspect
regionInstruct: Hover to snap · click to lock · drag for a free rectangle · Esc cancels
errRegionCrop: Could not crop the selected region.
errRegionStashMissing: Region snapshot expired or missing. Click the UniSS icon and start Region again.
regionExportFailed: Could not export the selection. Try again.
errQuota: Image is too large for browser storage. Try a smaller capture or download instead of Edit.
regionScrollCancelled: Page scrolled — region capture cancelled. Start Region again.
